name: Action Solar

about:
Action Solar is headquartered in Lehi, Utah. The company focuses on solar and storage installations for residential, commercial, and new-home customers.

The firm installs photovoltaic systems and battery storage, managing projects from initial consultation and site assessment through permitting and commissioning. In the past three years it has installed more than 557 megawatts of capacity across over 2,750 completed projects spanning 22 states.

Its customer base includes homeowners seeking to reduce electricity bills, businesses such as Walmart and Extra Space Storage that pursue cost savings and sustainability goals, and builders integrating solar into new construction. The company also assists clients with federal tax-credit applications and uses satellite imaging to evaluate roof shading.

Action Solar says it was founded to make clean energy affordable and accessible, emphasizing a seamless, personalized process for homeowners and energy-independence solutions for commercial clients. It positions its work as part of a broader effort to advance renewable energy adoption nationwide.
